original_text_preserved.verbatim: a check must carry a demonstrated failing case, or it counts as not implemented

the_revision.statement: A non-vacuity demonstration must from now on ALSO include a case that MUST RETURN POSITIVE. Cases that must return negative establish only that the rule cannot manufacture a positive; they cannot distinguish a working rule from one that always returns the negative.
minimum_demonstration: at least one case that must return the negative verdict
at least one case that must return the positive verdict

why_the_revision_exists.how_the_hole_was_found: the agent added a fourth case of its own accord during P-0, on the reasoning that three must-return-negative cases would be passed by a rule that always returns the negative, which would be as uninformative as one that always returns the positive
why_the_revision_exists.the_same_shape_as_OD_017: OD-017 exists because DC-005 was found only by producing an anomalous result, and a flattering divergence would never have surfaced. The hole here is the mirror image: a rule that can only fail in one direction cannot be shown to work by tests that only probe that direction
why_the_revision_exists.operator_assessment: recorded as an effective mechanism and added to the standing list

what_it_would_have_changed_had_it_been_i.in_EQ2: the band rule's non-vacuity demonstration covered the random lens, pure noise and an empty profile, all must-return-no-band. It did not demonstrate that the rule could return a band on a construction that should have one
what_it_would_have_changed_had_it_been_i.stated_carefully: this is an observation about the demonstration's coverage, NOT a claim that EQ2's determination was wrong. EQ2's NEGATIVE stands, is not reopened, and no EQ2 artifact is modified

first_application.outcome: case 2, a must-return-approximately-zero case, FAILED for the prescribed estimand, which halted the phase before any GPU work

claim_ceiling: A governance rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
